items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Keg Johnson in the context of other musicians who stayed in the West, and later suggests Keg Johnson may have been the scout who brought the interviewee's name up. The interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction with

ctx.x: I mean the fellows who came east, you know. Lot of fellows decided to stay out west. That's the story of lots of musicians because the city was (the bloom) they didn't want to get into. Like Dewey Jackson came here, he didn't want to be bothered. He wanted to turned around and/go back there. And, that's about -- no, Keg Johnson.
